name: Yakushima (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Yakushima town emblem in blue and green: a blue swirl with green stylised mountains and a blue disc.
history: Municipal flag of Yakushima, a town in Kagoshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 October 2007.

features.role: Yakushima town emblem — a blue swirl with green stylised mountains and a blue disc
